name: driver-food
description: SaaS multiempresa para operacao de pedidos, rotas e motoboys.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @driver-food/planner build && corepack pnpm --filter ./apps/api build && corepack pnpm --filter ./apps/web build
scripts.test: node --test scripts/package-manager-contract.test.mjs && corepack pnpm --filter @driver-food/planner test && corepack pnpm --filter ./apps/api test && corepack pnpm --filter ./apps/web test
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @driver-food/planner typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter ./apps/api typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter ./apps/web typecheck
scripts.check: corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build
